title: Business Central Under the Hood 9: The Engineering Systems Powering Business Central Development

chapters.title: Source Control Migration from Source Depot to Git
Git Migration Challenges and Version Support
Testing Infrastructure and Automation at Scale
Using Business Central as an Internal Platform
Engineering Systems Advice and Future Development Direction

features.name: Git Migration from Source Depot
features.description: Business Central migrated from Microsoft's internal Source Depot (based on Perforce) to Git to adopt industry standards and improve developer experience with distributed version control.
caveats: Binaries were problematic in Git and required special handling with symlinks
Complex history replay from Source Depot to Git was needed
Bridges were required to view pre-Git history

features.name: Automated Build Pipeline System
features.description: The Engineering Systems team manages approximately 70 different build pipelines across 100 active repositories that build multiple times daily, with every code commit triggering a new build across all 30+ language versions.
caveats: Requires up to 3000 machines running daily
Complex coordination across multiple versions and languages

features.name: Automated Test Infrastructure
features.description: A large-scale test system that runs approximately 40 million test cases per day across different versions, localizations, and configurations to validate changes before deployment.
caveats: Test volume varies based on development phase
Requires complex infrastructure to scale

features.name: Turn-Based Test Selection for Pull Requests
features.description: An intelligent PR validation system that uses code coverage data and build task dependency analysis to determine which tests should run based on the specific files changed in a pull request.
caveats: Requires comprehensive code coverage collection and file system tracking
Relies on accurate code coverage collection

features.name: Multi-Branch Release Strategy
features.description: Business Central maintains approximately 30 active branches for different versions with separate builds and release pipelines, including a master branch for next version development and release branches for shipped versions with backport capability.
caveats: Requires careful branch management and coordination
Backporting changes across branches adds complexity

features.name: Security Baseline and Permission Management
features.description: Continuous baseline management of security settings across repositories, ensuring no one has unnecessary permissions, requiring full-time employee sign-off on all code, two-person sign-off on release branches, and daily review of permission changes.
caveats: Requires manual review and approval processes

features.name: Component Governance and Supply Chain Security
features.description: Implementation of component governance tools to track all packages and dependencies used in builds, generating SBOMs to document what components are included and their sources, protecting against supply chain attacks.

features.name: Automated Certificate Management and Rotation
features.description: Certificates generated through Microsoft's onerent system, stored in key vaults with limited access, automatically rotated frequently, and can be rotated immediately if compromised.
caveats: Requires only specific identities to access certificates

features.name: Business Central as Internal Platform for Build System UI
features.description: A past initiative where Business Central's data-driven UI capabilities were leveraged to provide a front-end for the internal build system, allowing engineers to view builds, jobs, and log files without needing a custom-built UI.
caveats: This approach is no longer in use
Required removing most ERP functionality

features.name: Project Test Tolerance
features.description: A project to track test failures across multiple branches and builds, using heuristics to detect whether test failures are caused by the developer's changes or by other instabilities (like leap year bugs or month format changes), reducing false positives for developers.
caveats: Relies on heuristics that may not catch all cases

features.name: AL-GO Incremental Builds for GitHub
features.description: An improvement to AL-GO for GitHub where if only one of many projects in a CI/CD pipeline is modified, only that project is rebuilt and outputs from previous builds are reused, significantly reducing build and deployment times.
caveats: Requires careful output caching and dependency tracking

features.name: Managed DevBox Environments for Developers
features.description: Pre-configured development environments available via a web interface where developers can provision machines of various sizes (8, 16, or 32 CPUs) with all necessary tools pre-installed including SQL, compilers, Visual Studio Code, and SDKs.
caveats: Requires appropriate infrastructure investment

features.name: Virus Scanner Exclusions for Development Folders
features.description: Configuration of virus scanning exclusions on development machines for specific folders and processes to improve compilation and deployment speed, reducing deployment time from 15 minutes to 5 minutes while maintaining security through code review and testing.
caveats: Virus scanning is still enabled
Exclusions apply only to development
All code still reviewed before production
Still very secure
Code does not ship without testing
Code is reviewed by multiple people before production

features.name: Shared Test Tenant for All Developers
features.description: A fully deployed shared test tenant accessible to all developers with the latest bits from Master branch, allowing immediate access to test deployments without signup flow or environment setup delays.
caveats: Requires browser access
Simplified compared to previous signup flow

features.name: Official Builds Deployment to Test Environment
features.description: All official builds are deployed and developers can browse and select which builds to test, with automatic sign-in to Business Central for the selected build.

features.name: Private Branch Test Deployment Jobs
features.description: Developers can submit test jobs for feature branches or private development work, with the deployed environment appearing in the shared environment without requiring signup, allowing immediate testing of latest code.

features.name: AL-Go for GitHub
features.description: Recommended solution for partners developing AL code, providing automated build, test, deployment, and version control capabilities out of the box, eliminating the need to build custom engineering systems.
caveats: Partners should evaluate already available systems before building custom solutions

features.name: Azure DevOps for Engineering Systems
features.description: Recommended platform for partners building or managing engineering systems, with built-in version control, pull request review processes, and automation capabilities.

features.name: Automated Build and Test Infrastructure
features.description: Essential infrastructure components including automated builds on regular basis, version control, pull request review processes, testing, and sandbox deployments, which are considered fundamental for modern development workflows.
caveats: Requires significant infrastructure investment if building from scratch

features.name: Application Team Migration to AL-Go GitHub
features.description: Microsoft Business Central application team is gradually migrating internal application development from Azure DevOps to AL-Go with GitHub, moving towards dog-fooding the public solution and enabling open-source collaboration with partners.
caveats: Migration is gradual due to large legacy system
Still in progress
